description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for displaying web content within a Flutter app. It provides a `WebViewScreen` widget that loads an HTML asset from the app's assets directory, sanitizes input paths for security, manages a WebView controller, handles navigation events, and pre-checks for missing resource assets referenced within the HTML content. The class also includes detailed error handling and platform-specific loading strategies.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a web view loading a sanitized HTML asset. It provides an interface for passing the asset path and manages the web view's state, error handling, and resource checks.

classes.name: _WebViewScreenState
classes.description: State class for WebViewScreen that manages the WebViewController, loading states, error states, and resource verification logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the WebView controller, sanitizes the asset path, and begins loading the content with resource pre-checks.

methods.name: _sanitizeStrict
methods.description: Sanitizes the input path to ensure it's a safe and valid asset path under the assets directory, preventing path traversal and invalid references.

methods.name: _prepareAndLoad
methods.description: Loads the HTML asset, verifies its existence, extracts the title, checks referenced resources for missing files, and loads the content into the WebView based on platform.

methods.name: _extractTitle
methods.description: Extracts the `<title>` text from the HTML content for display purposes.

methods.name: _findMissingReferences
methods.description: Parses the HTML content to find references to CSS, JS, images, and checks their existence in assets; reports missing references.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI scaffold with AppBar, WebView, and error/loading overlays.
